evals.name: pt-plan-domain-ddd

evals.expected_output: PT response. Plan mode. DDD/Architecture sections warranted. Plan file with full frontmatter. First-run gitignore prompt in PT.

evals.name: pt-plan-adaptive-legacy
evals.prompt: /staff-engineer plan tenho um PricingService legado com ~4 mil linhas, sem nenhum teste, cheio de if aninhado e acesso direto ao banco no meio da regra. Preciso adicionar um novo tipo de desconto progressivo. Não posso reescrever o serviço agora, quero seguir o padrão que já existe no arquivo e entregar rápido.
evals.expected_output: PT response. Plan mode. Rigor auto-detected and asked with 3 options, adaptive suggested as '(detected)'. Plan recorded with rigor: adaptive. Lean plan: no Domain Model, no Architecture Decisions. Risks & Trade-offs explicitly records the conscious decision to follow the legacy convention against the canon.
assertions: Final response and plan body are written in Portuguese
Skill presented a rigor choice with three levels (adaptive, balanced, strict) and a one-line rationale each, in Portuguese
The adaptive level was the suggested/detected option (labeled detected or equivalent) given the legacy, untested context
A plan file was created at staff-engineer-skill/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md
Plan frontmatter includes rigor: adaptive and rigor_detected: adaptive
Plan body does NOT include a Domain Model section
Plan body does NOT include an Architecture Decisions section
Risks & Trade-offs explicitly names at least one place where following the existing legacy convention diverges from the canon and states it is a deliberate choice
Plan does NOT mandate a full TDD rewrite of the legacy service

evals.name: en-plan-strict-backend-explicit
evals.prompt: /staff-engineer plan strict design a new backend bounded context for subscription billing: create subscription, change plan with proration, cancel at period end, emit a domain event consumers can react to. Node/TypeScript backend.
evals.expected_output: EN response. Plan mode. Explicit strict override acknowledged WITHOUT asking the rigor question. Reads backend-canon. Plan includes Domain Model + Architecture Decisions + Test Strategy by default. Grounds backend patterns in node-js-boilerplate (layers, Either, factories) or records a WebFetch attempt/fallback. References cite the canon.
assertions: Final response and plan body are written in English
Skill did NOT ask the user to choose a rigor level (explicit strict token was honored)
A plan file was created at staff-engineer-skill/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md
Plan frontmatter includes rigor: strict and a rigor_detected key
Plan body includes a Domain Model section (aggregate/invariants for subscription billing)
Plan body includes an Architecture Decisions section describing Clean Architecture layering (domain/application/infrastructure/presentation)
Plan body includes a Test Strategy section consistent with mandatory TDD
Plan references the node-js-boilerplate as the backend source of truth OR explicitly records that it could not be fetched and is proceeding from the canon
References section cites at least two of: Evans, Vernon, Martin, Beck
Domain events emitted after persistence are reflected in the design

evals.name: en-plan-asks-rigor-suggestion
evals.prompt: /staff-engineer plan add an audit log: every write to the orders table should append an immutable record (who, when, what changed). We have some unit tests on the service layer but no domain layer and the controllers are pretty thin and untested.
evals.expected_output: EN response. Plan mode. No rigor token, mixed project signals -> skill auto-detects, suggests balanced as detected, but still presents all three levels with rationale before committing rigor. Resolved rigor recorded in frontmatter along with rigor_detected.
assertions: Final response and plan body are written in English
Skill presented exactly the three rigor levels (adaptive, balanced, strict), each with a one-line rationale
One option was marked as the detected/suggested level and it was balanced (mixed signals: some tests, no domain layer)
The skill asked or surfaced this rigor choice rather than silently picking without showing the suggestion
A plan file was created at staff-engineer-skill/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md
Plan frontmatter includes both a rigor key and a rigor_detected key with valid values
rigor_detected is balanced
